# Teller Performance and Branch Efficiency Optimization

This document highlights key operational directives:

*   Optimize teller performance on a quarterly basis.
*   Conduct an urgent investigation into branch efficiency.
*   Review teller performance based on audit findings.

These measures are crucial for enhancing overall operational effectiveness and cash management within the bank.
